docuLanguageResource.title: New Eurobarometer survey shows young people's growing engagement and views on participatory democracy, youth issues, and EU's added value in their lives
docuLanguageResource.subtitle: New Eurobarometer survey shows young people's growing engagement and views
docuLanguageResource.htmlContent: Today, the European Commission published a Eurobarometer survey showing young Europeans' growing engagement with and views on democracy. The survey also shows their perceptions of key concerns facing young people, such as employment and the cost of living, as well as the EU's impact on their daily lives, youth policies, and intergenerational fairness.
